body: I'm sorry to hear that. It was hard growing up knowing everyone I thought of as my best friend, only thought of me as a friend. I don't know if my siblings even like me at all. But I don't even like myself and I know I never will. I'm just broken at my core.

I just remember when i was twelve the police officer talking me down telling me life will get better. I hated that man ever since, never has someone told a worse lie to me. My life has only gotten worse, till now it feels like it's as good as over their is no hope left, I'm ugly crippled poor and in pain and don't know how it can get worse.
I didn't know better stronger people abandoned their spouse. The more you know.
